maria_support: hey @jon, saw ticket INC-1159 — users from your Okta SCIM push ended up with elevated roles after onboarding. can you share an example user + attrs?
jon_customer: thanks, noticed two accounts (uid: 0a3f9b) got team=eng-admin even though in Okta they're in Viewer group. attaching logs below.
jon_customer: ```json
{"user_id":"0a3f9b","okta_groups":["company/viewer"],"scim_payload":{"groups":[{"value":"company/viewer"}]}}
```
maria_support: can you confirm whether you used delegated admin or org-level SCIM? also did you re-run provisioning job or was it a one-off?
jon_customer: delegated admin on our side. we re-ran once after fixing a mapping script but saw the role flip back.
raj_engineering: assigning to me. @maria_support can you pull provisioning job id and timestamps? look for jobs with status=completed but applied_changes > 0 and audit log id.
maria_support: pulling now — job 39847 at 2026-03-17T09:02:03Z, 4 retries, final status completed. audit id audit-77f.
audit-bot: ALERT: provisioning-job-39847 had 4 retries, overall latency spike 5s->30s, KMS unwrap errors observed in attempt 2.
carol_security: KMS unwrap errors concern me. do we have HSM error codes? retention policy note: audit export retention for this tenant is 90 days, but they requested 1 year export for compliance — need legal signoff.
jon_customer: we have copy of HSM error: "unwrap failed: HSM-502 TIMEOUT" in the log bundle. also saw repeated PATCH /scim/v2/Users calls for the same user.
liz_prodops: possible race: SCIM retries + delegated admin mapping job caused duplicate role writes. can we repro with a sandbox tenant? raj_engineering: yes, I'll spin a repro with a simulated SCIM delta and KMS latency.
raj_engineering: repro steps I plan: 1) create user in Okta viewer group 2) trigger SCIM push with simulated KMS unwrap delay 3) force delegated-admin mapping change 4) run job 39847 codepath. I'll post the run id.
carol_security: until we confirm, please freeze role-change rollouts for this tenant and enable audit export to our secure bucket. need the export delivered to security@redwood.com. jon_customer: ack — please also provide a timeline and whether any secrets were exposed.
maria_support: creating emergency task: ENG-1204: reproduce+mitigate. @raj_engineering you'll have 24h to post findings. I'll escalate billing — tenant saw increased API retries, billing spike flagged.
jon_customer: thanks, really appreciate the rapid response :heart: 
raj_engineering: started repro, run id run-7721, ETA ~6h. posting logs once done.
maria_support: leash on role sync enabled for tenant. will follow up when run completes.
